`umami-kotlin` is a Kotlin Multiplatform Umami REST wrapper. Modules: `:umami` (core; `api`, `core`, `domain`), `:sample:simple-compose-app`, `:sample:terminalApp`. Uses Ktor, Kotlinx Coroutines/Serialization, `Channel`, `kotlin.time.Instant`, Kermit, Kotest, Mokkery; `UmamiOptionsBuilder` configures the `Umami` facade.

All contributions must adhere to the guidelines outlined in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

Gradle project. Detekt: `detekt/detekt.yml` (runs before git push); Qlty: `.qlty/qlty.toml`. Coverage enforced by Kover; minimums in root `build.gradle.kts`. Please ensure your changes do not introduce any new static analysis issues.

All new features must be accompanied by tests. Bug fixes should also include a test that reproduces the bug. All new tests should use Kotest matchers (e.g., `shouldBe`) instead of `kotlin.test` assertions.
